name: step3-prompt-edit-in-results
summary: Added inline prompt editing to the review result dialog and closed Phase 5.
completed_work: Added editingId and editingPrompt state to DocumentReviewDialog.
Added a Pencil icon button for each review result prompt.
Rendered an inline Textarea with Save and Cancel controls for the active result.
Saved prompt edits to commonReviewItemStorage or reviewItemStorage and updated local dialog state without refetching results.
Marked Phase 5 completed in phases/index.json and wrote the Phase 5 baseline.
decisions: Only prompts are editable; markdown review result bodies remain read-only.
Prompt saves update local state directly instead of calling fetchResults().
Storage update calls include the existing item name because the current storage contract requires name and prompt together.

verification.note: Home route loaded with expected Korean document review UI text. Browser policy blocked localStorage seeding for dialog-state verification, so dialog behavior was verified by typecheck/build and targeted code checks.

known_issues: Existing unrelated .gitignore and step0-step3 markdown edits remain in the worktree and were not reverted.
phases/3-provider-model-ui/index.json still has stale pending step statuses even though top-level status, manifest, baseline, and tag indicate Phase 3 completion.
next_actions: Create git tag STD-ReviewDoC-phase5-done after the step3 commit.
resume_hint: Phase 5 is complete after this step. Future work should read phases/baselines/5-scoring-prompt-edit.json and phases/project-manifest.json before inspecting implementation files.
